lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in semi-regular vertical columns along the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the branchial region. Column spacing appears relatively uniform relative to the longitudinal axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with longitudinal rows of blobs, forming a discernible grid-like matrix of anchor nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal linear ridges are visible on the upper flank, exhibiting a sharp light-to-shadow vertical gradient. The uppermost ridge follows the curvature of the dorsal midline.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, low-contrast high-luminance blobs scattered across the leading edge and central surface of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, elongated dark silhouettes (remoras) are visible swimming in close proximity to the ventral surface of the shark.
